##### Project general facts

Nirvana Residences 1 by Meraki Developers is a refined residential project set on a prime corner plot in Dubai Production City, designed to stand out through its modern architecture and smart planning. The project offers a well-balanced mix of studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments. With efficient layouts, strong access, and an elegant design, project presents itself as a highly desirable option for both residents and investors. 

The amenities at Nirvana Residences 1 are thoughtfully curated to support an active, relaxed, and social lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a beautifully designed swimming pool, indoor and outdoor gyms, outdoor yoga spaces, padel court, and inviting seating areas that create a resort-like feel. These facilities are seamlessly integrated into the podium and landscaped areas, offering a calm retreat within a vibrant urban setting. 

Apartments at Nirvana Residences 1 are semi-furnished, ensuring convenience from day one while allowing residents to personalize their space. Kitchens come equipped with quality appliances, paired with modern cabinetry and practical layouts that enhance daily living. High-quality materials, elegant finishes, and large windows bring warmth, light, and a sense of understated luxury to every home.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

Dubai Production City also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
